question: Did real GDP shrink in Q3 2017, i.e. was real GDP (GDPC1) in Q3 2017 lower than in Q2 2017?
notes: Definition: yes iff level(q) < level(q-1 quarter); a tie is no. question: Was July 2018 the weakest of the 12 months ending in July 2018 for payroll growth, i.e. was the monthly change in total nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) in July 2018 lower than in each of the 11 months before it?
notes: Definition: yes iff change(t) is strictly lower than each of change(t-1) .. change(t-11), where change(m) = level(m) - level(m-1); any tie is no.
